limitations: Seasonal full-body costumes appear at rest and in seasonal scenes. Classic locomotion, feeding and reminder artwork stays in its own compatible wardrobe; 27-by-16 fully costumed variants are not supplied.
Scene sheets are chronological key poses with deliberate holds, not rigged motion-capture or continuously interpolated joint animation.
Festival dates are curated for 2026 and 2027 with editable local ranges; future lunar years require date updates.
Review covers bundled output and the packaged Windows test environment, not every possible user DPI or monitor arrangement.
